meta.stage: Stage-1 supplementary robustness: Y_tight/Y_loose ratio sweep
meta.note: mt29_stage1_matched_yield_fix.py fixes Y_tight = Y_loose // 2 (ratio 0.5) once, post hoc, with no sensitivity sweep. This script reruns the identical matched-yield machinery for Y_tight = round(Y_loose * ratio) at ratio in {1/3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6} on the same cached WBM predictions to test whether the headline interaction and the CHGNet oxide-vs-halide cell survive the choice of ratio.
